### Issue description

In 3D, in the previous versions, you could press `Ctrl + 2` to open two splits in the 3D workspace. It no longer works in `v4.4.rc1.official [8ed125b42]`

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new `Node3D`.
Select the `Node3D` in the 3D viewport
Press `Ctrl + 2`.
It worked in 4.2 and 4.3, but not in `v4.4.rc1.official [8ed125b42]`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This setup above is the minimal reproduction project.
